Ribbon icons — all 122

Every icon the ribbon, the quick access toolbar and the layout Insert rail use, at 32 px (large buttons, rail) and 16 px (small buttons, menus, quick access), light and dark, beside the one-colour Fluent icon each had before. The 16 px drawings drop fine detail and use a heavier line. Rules: docs/DECISIONS.md, "Ribbon icons".
